about_the_game:
Small robots from various places have launched rebellions. Faced with the surging small robots, two legendary idols have stepped forward. They are the idols of the Undead Bird Clan and the Frost Dragon Clan. Use their unique power to survive in endless siege and defeat the ultimate boss!

Game features:

The weapon is preset for automatic shooting, and you only need to control the character's movement and release powerful character killing skills at the appropriate time to reverse the situation.

The pace is fast, with a total of 20 levels. Enemy attacks in each level will last for 20-90 seconds. Find a way to eliminate more enemies during this period and survive!

Dozens of props and weapons for you to choose from (all kinds of super funny props)! Reasonably match props and weapons to form the strongest configuration!

After each wave of enemies ends, a super manager will appear. If hit by it, the hard-earned resources will be taken away! Should we continue collecting the remaining resources on the map or evacuate quickly? Please make a quick choice!
